itr_form_reasoning: Graphic/UI design is a notified profession eligible for presumptive taxation under section 44ADA. Gross receipts (Rs 11,00,000) are within the Rs 75,00,000 44ADA threshold (enhanced limit applies since >95% of receipts are via banking channels). No need to maintain books of account or get audited.

regime_comparison.note: New regime wins: presumptive income (Rs 5,50,000) plus interest (Rs 3,000) = Rs 5,53,000 total income, below the Rs 12,00,000 rebate threshold so slab tax is fully rebated to nil. Old regime's 80C/80D deductions (Rs 32,000) don't help enough to beat the new-regime rebate.

Gross receipts Rs 11,00,000 are below the Rs 20,00,000 GST registration threshold for services -- no GST registration required.
